_comment: TEMPLATE - NOT YET VERIFIED AGAINST HARDWARE. Two things must happen before this is trustworthy: (1) the board needs firmware 1.50+ (it ships 1.44, which is keyboard-only), and (2) the joystick direction encoding needs confirming by dumping the config before and after a Start1+P1SW2 mode switch and diffing. `apply` will warn if the firmware cannot act on these codes.
_sticks_note: Stick pins (1up/1down/1left/1right, 2up/...) are deliberately absent. Pins a profile does not mention keep whatever the board already has, so this file will not break your sticks. Whether directions want HAT 0..3, ANALOG 0..7 or GAMEPAD codes is the open question the dump diff answers - add them here once known.
